intro: Visual work, music, and objects made with curiosity, feeling, and a little bit of the unexpected.
bio: Born in the Pacific Northwest and raised in the Midwest, Hollie Hix is a professional mixed-media artist from Southern Illinois who challenges the status quo. Her work explores creativity as a force for personal freedom, drawing inspiration from a lifetime spent pursuing diverse artistic disciplines. While most people dedicate their lives to one thing, she has explored many creative avenues, drawing inspiration for both her visual work and her career as a singer-songwriter. With six studio albums released, Hix has won multiple awards for her songs Into the Light, My Only One, and On My Own. Having performed on stages both big and small, her passion also lies in studio art, where her creativity knows no bounds. Hix began her formal artistic training in 2012 at the Academy of Art University in San Francisco, studying oil painting and figure drawing at age 15. After taking time away from school to tour, she continued her education at Southwestern Illinois College, where she received her Associate of Fine Arts degree in 2023. That fall, she began pursuing her Bachelor of Fine Arts degree at Southern Illinois University Edwardsville, graduating in 2026. Passionate about both artmaking and education, Hix aims to create a studio environment where artists can develop their skills, confidence, and creative voices. Through her work, she encourages viewers to embrace imagination, challenge the norm, and recognize creativity as a pathway to connection and freedom.
aboutMe: My current works deal with what it means to be a saint in everyday life. My work explores the connections between identity, creativity, motherhood, sacrifice, and the everyday experiences that shape us. You can find my work, We Are Mothers, Martyrs, Saints, at the gallery at SIUE in Art and Design West. The exhibition opens November 19, 2026, and remains on view through December 4, 2026.
